ai.label: Character Group
ai.description: Invite different characters and models to chat, brainstorm, and compare perspectives.

agent.label: Expert Group
agent.description: Invite experts with clear roles to collaborate on plans, reviews, and conclusions.

cli.label: Dev Group
cli.description: Invite Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, KimiCode, PI, and other CLI Agents to edit code together.

smart.label: Smart pick
smart.description: Pick the most relevant characters based on the message. Good for everyday chat.

round_robin.label: Round robin
round_robin.description: Members reply in turn. Good for long-running companion-style conversations.

all.label: Full roundtable
all.description: Every character speaks each round. Good for brainstorming and model comparison.

quick_response.label: Quick response
quick_response.description: Automatically assign one CLI Agent to handle it directly. Good for small edits, simple fixes, and one-off requests.

diagnose_fix_review.label: Diagnose, fix, review
diagnose_fix_review.description: A fixer diagnoses and edits code first, then a reviewer checks the fix quality. Good when the user only describes a bug symptom.

implement_review.label: Plan, implement, review
implement_review.description: Plan first, then implement, then review. Good for new features, refactors, and cross-module changes.

review_fix.label: Review and fix
review_fix.description: Review existing changes or current code first, then fix based on feedback. Good for follow-up fixes after review.

discussion.label: Read-only discussion
discussion.description: Analyze plans, risks, and debugging ideas without changing the workspace. Good before committing to edits.

multi_solution.label: Multiple solutions
multi_solution.description: Multiple CLI Agents propose implementations or plans side by side. Good when the direction is uncertain.

isolated_race.label: Isolated race
isolated_race.description: Multiple CLI Agents implement in isolated worktrees, then you choose which result to adopt. Good for complex tasks or model races.

common.label: Common
common.description: Covers most day-to-day development tasks. Start here first.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.description: For existing reviews, comparing multiple approaches, or isolated parallel implementation.

task.label: Per task
task.description: Each dev task gets its own CLI session. Continuing the same task reuses that session.

workspace.label: Per workspace
workspace.description: All tasks under the same workspace and CLI Agent share one CLI session.

template.label: Per template
template.description: All tasks created from the same team template share one CLI session with the weakest isolation.
